org.name: Hartwell Labs
org.description: Independent engineering company from Szczecin, Poland. Security infrastructure, developer tools and one proprietary intelligence platform.

products.name: talus-process-monitor
products.tagline: eBPF ransomware detection with auto-kill for Linux
products.description: Endpoint detection & response agent for Linux, written in Rust. eBPF tracepoints (execve/openat/unlink/mkdir) score a 1-second sliding window per process and SIGKILL threats automatically. Single static binary, no kernel module, no signatures. The agent sandboxes itself (CAP_BPF|CAP_PERFMON|CAP_NET_ADMIN, seccomp + Landlock).

products.name: externum
products.tagline: A typed language that compiles to readable Python, Bash and native bytecode
products.description: Self-hosted programming language: pattern matching and pipeline syntax compile to readable Python, Bash and native EXBC bytecode. Ships a REPL and a Pro Pack toolchain, 400+ tests.

products.name: quantum-shield
products.description: Single static CLI that encrypts files with ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation and AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption. Pipes into scripts, backups and CI.

products.name: linux-aegis
products.tagline: Stackable Linux Security Module (LSM) with in-tree upstream patches
products.description: Feature-flagged LSM layers shipped as in-tree patches, with CI and QEMU boot tests.

products.name: fortis
products.tagline: RISC-V chain-of-trust with measured boot on QEMU virt
products.description: Bare-metal RISC-V chain of trust: real SHA-256 and ML-KEM-768 post-quantum measured boot.

products.name: labtrace
products.tagline: Forensic timeline reconstruction for Linux audit telemetry
products.description: Rules LT001-LT010 find single-event signals; taint tracking propagates sensitive data through file writes, exec arguments and child processes; correlation fuses findings sharing a process chain into ranked incidents. No agent required on the host.

products.name: labbridge
products.tagline: Rust to Ruby bridge for Hartwell Labs programs
products.description: Translate Hartwell Labs Rust to runnable Ruby, and Ruby plugins back into Rust via the LabPlugin trait. Targets verified against the Products Registry.

products.name: CyberForge
products.tagline: Four Rust security tools: recon, web, hash and packets
products.description: ShadowScan, PacketEye, NetRecon and HashSleuth in one Tokio async workspace, published to crates.io.

products.name: hack-the-lab
products.tagline: Break our products before someone else does
products.description: Security challenges, CVE credits and the Hartwell Labs Hall of Fame.

products.name: scryer-core
products.description: Public-intelligence ingestion (BZP/BIP), KSC/NIS2 scoring and passive DNS audit. Self-hosted, access on request, security-first.

products.name: photoscrub
products.tagline: See what your photos leak, then remove it
products.description: Finds GPS coordinates, embedded thumbnails, body serials, XMP/IPTC fields, PNG text chunks, data appended after the image, GPS in video containers and PII in free text, then writes metadata-free copies. Passive, local, no upload. Windows and Linux. Source is closed; licence keys are Ed25519-signed and machine-bound.

products.name: TrustNode
products.tagline: A Solana-like validator built from scratch in Rust
products.description: PoH clock, Tower BFT consensus, Sealevel-style parallel execution, Turbine propagation with Reed-Solomon erasure coding, CRDS gossip over real UDP, fee-priority mempool and an SBF-inspired program executor. 12 crates, 228 tests. Research-grade: never run on mainnet.
